rules: sha256 is null if and only if status is selected-pending-download.
files[] is optional. When present, sha256 is the aggregate: sha256 of the lines '<file sha256>  <path>' sorted by path, joined with \n, with no trailing newline (utf-8).
rigged is null until a downloaded file confirms it.
CC-BY-SA entries are allowed only for reference photos, per Alex's decision on issue #29; ShareAlike applies to any texture derived from them.
